messages:
marta: Noticing an uptick in GPU attach failures in us-west1 since ~02:45 UTC. Threads show mount errors on scratchpool nodes.
ryan: I pulled logs for three affected gnodes: gnode-143, gnode-198, gnode-211. NVMe controller timeouts and several reassign events on 143.
anika: Snippet from gnode-143 dmesg:
```
[Sat Apr 10 02:47:12] nvme0: I/O 98765 QID 5 timeout, aborting
[Sat Apr 10 02:47:13] nvme0: timeout waiting for completion
[Sat Apr 10 02:47:14] nvme0: reassigning LBA range, reallocated_sector_count +1
[Sat Apr 10 02:47:16] blk_update_request: I/O error, dev nvme0n1, sector 2078928
```
ryan: Timeline shows ephemeral-cleaner started heavy scrub at 02:44 and batch scheduler launched GPU scale-up at 02:46. Likely IOPS contention.
sre-bot: [alert] nvme_reassign_threshold crossed on gnode-143 (warning).
dev-gor: Hypothesis: scrub + small-file churn + write bursts from training causing controller queues to spike -> drive protective behavior (reassigns).
anika: Quick mitigation idea: reduce cleaner concurrency from 12 to 4 and add jittered windows across AZs. I tested a patch on a staging node: `concurrency: 4, window: 03:30-04:30, jitter: 6m`.
marta: Good. @sam can you run a 5-node canary with that config and monitor attach success and iowait?
sam: Rolling to 5 canaries in us-west1 now. Adding blkio throttle for cleaner process too.
ops-jen: Cost note: if reassigns keep growing we'll need to schedule NVMe replacements (~$6k per rack + downtime). Prefer config fix first.
ryan: Short-term: deploy scrub concurrency change + blkio cgroup limits for cleaner. Medium-term: implement low-write scrub mode and auto-deprioritize nodes with rapid SMART reassign growth.
dev-gor: I'll prototype auto-deprioritize: when reassign_count > 3 within 30m, mark node non-preferred for attaches for 30m. Low-risk fallback.
anika: Pushed scrub patch to staging and updated ops config: `ops/configs/blkio-scrub.toml`. Throttle command used: `echo 500 > /sys/fs/cgroup/blkio/cleaner/blkio.throttle.read_iops_device`.
sam: Canary update after 20m: attach success jumped from ~86% -> 98% on the 5 nodes, iowait down ~60%, SMART reassign counters stable. Extending to 20 nodes in 20m.
ops-jen: If canary holds, plan: 1) cluster roll of scrub concurrency + blkio QoS 2) schedule drive replacements for sustained SMART growth next quarter 3) inform finance for CAPEX.
marta: I'll open a follow-up ticket and loop in customer-success if SLA windows were affected. ry an please add dashboard: reassign_count vs attach_fail rate per node.
ryan: On it. Will add alert if attach_fail > 5% and reassign_count increasing.
anika: Links: https://git.internal/ops/cleaner/+/reduce-concurrency and https://git.internal/ops/configs/blkio-scrub.toml
marta: Marking incident as active until rollouts complete. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
